name: Filament Unger (Unger GmbH & Co. KG)
summary: Filament line of Unger GmbH & Co. KG, a fourth-generation family plastics processor founded in 1952 in Schopfheim, Baden-Wuerttemberg (HRA 670372 Freiburg). Production is in-house in Germany under ISO 9001, with a short catalogue of mainstream grades on AMS-compatible spools.
additional_notes: Pricing roughly EUR 23-26/kg. The filament brand is young but the parent has processed plastics since 1952, which is the basis for the in-house German production claim; ISO 9001 certification is stated by the company. Spools are marketed as AMS-compatible.
